title: Portal Discovery
prompt:
Clean black-and-white children’s coloring-book line art with bold ink outlines on white, no shading or gray. Elliott (age 4–5, short light-brown hair, gray-blue eyes, round cheeks) and Colette (age 2–3, brown hair in a small top knot, gray-blue eyes, soft toddler cheeks) must resemble the attached reference children and not generic cartoon kids; keep natural child proportions and recognizable faces. Winnie, a small tan Chihuahua–Pug mix with upright ears and a curled tail, is with them. Scene: in a forest clearing the children and Winnie discover a large swirling magical portal rising behind them toward the top of the page, with outline silhouettes of two friendly winged dragons inside while tall trees and hanging vines frame the scene.

Use the attached character sheet reference images as the canonical identity and style.
